name: CEO
description: Owner of the platform. Every permission; cannot be edited, deleted or suspended.

name: AdminManager
description: Runs the admin team: approvals, people, orders, support, designs and content. No money sending.

name: Support
description: Answers customers, partners and sellers; handles returns.

name: Finance
description: CFO team: withdrawals, refunds, credits, revenue and money approvals (preparing and sending are done by two different people).

name: Content
description: Banners, pop-ups, news, help, legal drafts, categories and holidays.

name: Marketing
description: Promo codes, broadcasts, banners, fantasy and tournaments (no revenue view: separation of duties).

name: Moderator
description: Keeps communities, games, reviews and designs clean.

name: AgentBase
description: Base role of every AI agent; each agent gets its own permissions on top.

name: Customer
description: Books pitches, joins games, shops and plays fantasy.

name: PitchOwner
description: Pitch partner: manages their own venues, pitches, bookings and staff.

name: Seller
description: Print-on-demand seller: their own designs, store and earnings.

name: FactoryOwner
description: Factory partner: their own jobs, staff, devices and prices.

name: FactoryStaff
description: Factory worker signed in on a registered device with a PIN.
